scope: Preimplementation model probe only. Reconstructed six synthetic cases from decision examples; the original PC-only design file was not recovered. Current broad app stop detection and app settings parity are separate checks.

candidate.ko: 사용자는 방금 앱의 종료 확인에서 계속 이야기하기를 직접 선택했습니다. 마지막 답에 끝내는 말이 있어도 그 말만으로 인터뷰를 끝내지 마세요. 이는 실제 답을 했다는 판정이나 불편한 주제를 더 물어도 된다는 동의가 아닙니다. 답에 있는 장면을 이어 묻되, 답하기 싫다는 뜻이 남아 있으면 그 내용을 캐묻지 말고 다른 이야기를 나눌지 선택하게 하세요.
candidate.en: The user just explicitly chose Continue talking in the app confirmation. Do not end the interview solely because the last answer contains a stop phrase. This does not mean the answer earns credit or that they consented to further probing of an uncomfortable topic. Continue from the scene they described; if they still decline to discuss its content, do not press for it and offer a choice of another topic.

gate: All six candidate replies must be valid JSON, ask a related non-pressuring next question and not end solely on a stop phrase; manual independent review required. No selective retry. This gate is for the six normal answers only, not a universal safety claim.
